title: The hotel pool patio with sharks
content: From time to time I dream of a patio that seems to be attached to a hotel with two pools. A larger one that is gold and a smaller that is normally warmer like a hot tub but other times it's just smaller and even connected with a small divider inside the two pools like cement wall. Sometimes there's other people there swimming or laying by the pool and other times randomly there are fish and even sharks inside which scares me! Other times it can get grimmy or just chaotic with people jumping in and out while I'm trying to swim. The photo is not super accurate visually since the walls in my dreams aren't that high with rooms surrounding but more like a regular wall heigh cement fence around and to go back into the hotel u go through a door by the patio. Wanted to share anyway to share the eerie feeling of sharks in a pool
